primary_target: independently measured clinical Neutrophils_percent, percent units
purpose: Assess whether the original frozen AD-triage gene modules predict a real immune-background factor; not AD diagnosis in infection patients.
sample_join: Exact GEO TPM column = deidentified_patient_metadata.Albany_sampleID; exclude ambiguous combined IDs rather than resolve by position.
outer_cv: 5-fold shuffled StratifiedKFold on COVID status, identical folds across models
inner_cv: 4-fold shuffled StratifiedKFold on COVID status; nested selection by MAE
transform_target: None; percentage points; predictions clipped to [0,100]
gene_transform: log2(TPM+1); no phenotype-selected genes or batch correction
module_transform: Original membership and loading signs, original module denominators; log-expression gene z means/SD learned from each training fold only; missing genes zero. This is a new CBC predictor and does not modify original AD classifier.
markers: The same seven eligible stage50 MCPcounter marker mean-expression panels, no new outcome-selected marker genes
clinical_inputs: Age, male indicator, missing-sex indicator; no disease label, ICU/severity score, CBC, CRP, protein or target-derived inputs
outer_fold_preprocessing: All gene scaling, feature standardization and model fitting trained without held-out samples, including every inner split
uncertainty: 2000 paired subject bootstrap draws of saved OOF predictions; conditional resampling CI does not quantify full model-selection/training uncertainty
transport_stress: COVID train -> nonCOVID hospital patients, and reverse; fit all preprocessing in training background and tune by training-only 4-fold KFold. This is background holdout within one study, not independent-cohort validation.
permutation_control: 100 target permutations within COVID backgrounds with fixed alpha=10 for age_sex_frozen8; global null check, no retuning to improve observed performance
interpretation: Never claim a novel algorithm or validated deployable model from internal CV; require a second independently measured public blood-factor cohort before transport-validation claims.
clinical_measurement_timing: Routine clinical value linked by sample record; exact interval relative to RNA venipuncture not documented in inspected database. Do not call this synchronized same-draw validation.
